posts.text: We don’t have a problem with the fact that an image exists of Trump depicted as Jesus.  We have a problem with the fact that the sitting president of United States saw that image of himself and decided to share it with millions of people.  But clearly @Grant Stinchfield didn’t understand that.

Hundreds of social media accounts have cropped up overnight featuring attractive, women, military, and law-enforcement, sharing pro Trump political messages. The only problem? They’re all AI and none of them is marked as such.

President Donald Trump and Secretary of health and human services RFK Jr. Talked about Trump’s claim that he lowered drug prices by 600%. Both maintain that lowering a price by 600% as possible, and it’s just a “different way of calculating“

During a congressional testimony under oath, secretary of commerce Howard Lutnick admitted to Congress that the United States government had only approved one application for the gold card visa program launched by Trump last year. The program started accepting applications in December 2025 and Lutnick had boosted about tens of thousands of applications haven’t been received so far.  The program allows for a nationals to receive a green card after investing $1 million.

Many Democrats, including former vice president Kamala Harris, are complaining about the unnecessary spike and crude oil and gas prices in the United States.  Some people, including @carterking_2025 , remind us that, under the Biden-Harris administration gas Prices also went up. The difference, however, is substantial.

A Virginia circuit court judge has issued an emergency injunction, blocking the implementation of the new congressional district maps approved by voters in Virginia after the referendum on April 21 Judge Jack Hurley Junior, of Tazewell County, argued that the referendum did not follow the proper constitutional procedure and that every ballot cast is therefore invalid.  The decision will be quickly appealed by the state of Virginia.

Lara Trump shared her opinion about the Virginia referendum that temporarily drew new congressional maps. She called it a “power grab” by the Democrats. Lara Trump, however, does not remember when she applauded Texas doing the same thing but without a referendum, and had absolutely no problem when other states, including Missouri, North Carolina, and Utah, tried to do it to favor the GOP and under request by President Donald Trump.

When Caitlyn Jenner renewed her passport, the government changed the gender marker in it to “M” for male.  This follows presidential guidelines in Trump’s executive order that establishes that the government only recognizes two genders, which are immutable and decided at conception.  This is exactly what Caitlyn Jenner voted for.

Congressional term limits: Do republicans in Congress want congressional term limits more than democrats? People like @Robert seem to think so, but the truth is very different.  Sen. Ted Cruz has introduced the very same bill every two years since 2017, knowing that it would fail in the Senate judiciary committee, which has been controlled by Republicans almost this entire time.  #termlimits #tedcruz #factcheck
